title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 55 Grasso Plaza in St. Louis, Missouri, as the "Sgt. Amanda N. Pinson Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 55 Grasso Plaza in St. Louis, Missouri, as the "Sgt. Amanda N. Pinson Post Office."

summary.headline: A 2015 law renames a St. Louis, Missouri Postal Service facility the "Sgt. Amanda N. Pinson Post Office."
summary.what_it_does: This law officially names the Postal Service facility at 55 Grasso Plaza in St. Louis, Missouri, after Sgt. Amanda N. Pinson. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on November 5, 2015.
